postrace_analysis.method: Compare documented pre-race reasons with independently published results; distinguish evidence available before racing from explanations discovered afterward. Associations are not causal proof. No outcome-derived features enter live model.

oct31.interpretation: Average model gap/score separated wins only weakly in one sample; high separation did not prevent large misses. Attribution to individual coefficients is impossible without saved feature-level model decomposition.

cases.pre_race_strength: Three recent Group 1 wins, five consecutive top-two Group 1 finishes and elite Randwick form
cases.pre_race_risk: Strong Golden Eagle field, 1500m after 2000m, traffic and pace
cases.retrospective_interpretation: Elite Group 1 form was genuine, but 1500m/strong Golden Eagle opposition made the very large 18.64pp separation unreliable.

cases.pre_race_strength: Third in Group 1 Thousand Guineas then drops to Group 3 Vanity at proven 1400m; legitimate class relief
cases.pre_race_risk: Only four career runs; Pin Up Sheila and I Am Aria are credible rivals
cases.retrospective_interpretation: Group 1 to Group 3 class relief worked as anticipated; prior small sample was a real uncertainty, not a reason to erase the winner.

cases.pre_race_strength: Six top-three outcomes from seven starts, won 1600m and two Soft runs; strong last-start Ascot effort
cases.pre_race_risk: Wider gate 10 and stronger class; Decoration gains gate/relative-weight advantage
cases.retrospective_interpretation: Progressive consistency and last-start Ascot form transferred despite wide draw; gap signal supported winner in this instance.

cases.pre_race_strength: Multiple Group 1 wins and recent Toorak victory at the mile with McDonald booked
cases.pre_race_risk: Surfin' Bird, Idle Flyer, Concord Connie and a potentially unhelpful pace
cases.retrospective_interpretation: Class and recent Group 1 form were relevant; race result supports the broad selection, not proof of exact 24.04% model estimate.

cases.pre_race_strength: Two successive Sydney wins and 2000m form, just 53.5kg and barrier five
cases.pre_race_risk: Seven-day backup, Listed step up, Starzintheireyes and Barrengarry
cases.retrospective_interpretation: Strong Sydney form and light weight were insufficient; Listed step, backup and rivals needed more weight.

cases.pre_race_strength: Group 2 winning form and Group 1 Thousand Guineas second; stepping back to Group 2 Wakeful
cases.pre_race_risk: First test at 2000m; De Armas has stronger-looking staying profile
cases.retrospective_interpretation: Group-level ability predicted competitiveness (third), but 2000m stamina test was not strong enough to select for the win.

cases.pre_race_strength: Four wins from five; two wins at Flemington and recent Group 2 Roman Consul win, barrier four
cases.pre_race_risk: First Group 1 versus The Next Episode, St Gotthard and Natural Fling; straight-six pattern
cases.retrospective_interpretation: Recent win/track record was overstated against Group 1 straight-track opposition; The Next Episode, flagged as a danger, won.

cases.pre_race_strength: Eight lifetime wins including two Listed races; four wins at 1000m and documented wet-track form
cases.pre_race_risk: Last start 5.9 lengths off winner, 58.5kg, Oscar's Fortune and others
cases.retrospective_interpretation: Recorded ability found the first two, but last-start defeat/weight opposition remained material.

cases.pre_race_strength: Seven wins in eight starts, unbeaten from three Ascot runs and drawn inside
cases.pre_race_risk: Untried Soft 5, Playin'it Sweet receives 2.5kg better relative terms, Bonjoy a proven stakes rival
cases.retrospective_interpretation: Exceptional Ascot winning record translated; lower formal tier on Soft 5 uncertainty proved overly cautious for actual win.

cases.pre_race_strength: Recent Manikato Group 1 winner, three 1300m wins and previous winner of Russell Balding Stakes
cases.pre_race_risk: Gate 16 in crowded Group 2; Ninja, Headwall and Grafterburners strong rivals
cases.retrospective_interpretation: Group 1 victory was not enough to bridge crowded field, outside draw and quality opposition.

cases.pre_race_strength: Three consecutive Group 3 sprint placings this campaign, two previous Flemington wins, drawn barrier 3 with 55kg; form is proven in Group races.
cases.pre_race_risk: Flying For Fun has a recent Group 2 second, 1100m Flemington straight and early-pace dynamics; front-running efforts can get overrun.
cases.retrospective_interpretation: Group 3 placings did not overcome pace/straight-course challenges; Flying For Fun, flagged as danger, won.

cases.pre_race_strength: Karrakatta Plate Group 2 winner and close runner-up in 10 October Max Simmonds, on the same 59kg as latest meeting with Aurum Belle; a win and second in two Soft starts.
cases.pre_race_risk: Draw 9 is outside; needs clear late path. Aurum Belle has three Good wins, and Good 4 can reverse model leader; never call this a stable lock.
cases.retrospective_interpretation: Draw and stronger rivals were relevant; runner finished second, not winner. Actual starter changes affected race shape.

cases.pre_race_strength: All five career starts placed, recent Belmont 1000m victory by approximately 2.1 lengths, barrier 1 and 55kg at first try 1100m.
cases.pre_race_risk: First run at 1100m and stronger older sprint opposition; Delzee, proven at 1100m, won at Ascot latest and draws gate 2. Inside trap/pace risk.
cases.retrospective_interpretation: Lightly raced profile and inside draw were not enough for class rise and first 1100m test.

cases.pre_race_strength: Six wins from eleven starts and four wins in four documented 1100m attempts; latest open handicap win by approximately 3.9 lengths.
cases.pre_race_risk: Latest win was at Dubbo, versus deeper Randwick BM78 opposition; Compensation, Sylph and other metropolitan sprinters could expose class jump. Strong class-assumption sensitivity.
cases.retrospective_interpretation: Very large model separation was misleading: Dubbo-to-Randwick class uncertainty was insufficiently controlled.

cases.pre_race_strength: Four wins and two placings from seven; unbeaten in three attempts at 1200m and three wins from four Soft starts; barrier 4 and competitive handicap weight.
cases.pre_race_risk: First-up after 77 days, sharper trip than recent 1650m second; Like Clockwork, Cinque Stelle are race-fit or strong resumes; Good 4 changes projected leader.
cases.retrospective_interpretation: Recent winning form remained competitive (third), but first-up/trip adjustment and rivals prevented a win.

tiers.warning: One Saturday sample. Archived ranked form tier and model percent are different constructs.

cases.known_before: Proven top-class ability confirmed in Champions Mile; field reduction another known benefit
cases.interpretation: Relative opposition and class advantage were credible; actual winner was a short-priced favourite
cases.limitation: Rival strength still mattered, especially Lindermann

cases.known_before: Strong 1400m form and advantageous draw were documented pre-race
cases.interpretation: Strong class/race-fit profile supported win; Gerringong pushed her closely
cases.limitation: Pre-race 65% working share not independently calibrated

cases.known_before: Everest victory and six-race streak; Giga Kick/Rey Magnerio out
cases.interpretation: These were insufficient to offset an untested Flemington straight and long preparation
cases.limitation: First straight run; post-race respiratory issue and trainer fatigue remarks are POST-RACE evidence only
Roger was withdrawn late; this is after the saved morning snapshot

cases.known_before: Strong Eurythmic form documented in pre-race report
cases.interpretation: Race class record was consistent with winning

cases.known_before: Expected to benefit from a softer 2400m tempo after Savisanta/Smart Jazz scratches
cases.interpretation: Staying suitability and accessible pace position aligned with winning
cases.limitation: Criteria still a legitimate rival pre-race

cases.known_before: Wheely scratched; favourable six draw noted
cases.limitation: Not independently evidence of formula coefficient

cases.known_before: Cox Plate win and Flemington 2000m suitability; Birdman flagged as danger
cases.interpretation: Top-two result confirms broad class assessment
cases.limitation: Birdman had beaten him in Underwood and was held up in Cox Plate; more weight needed on rival trajectory

cases.known_before: Melbourne-to-Sydney class transfer and pace both explicitly flagged
cases.interpretation: No evidence this was sufficiently resolved before assigning 32.3%
cases.limitation: Sixth of eight, settled sixth; class transfer and race setup were under-controlled risks

cases.known_before: Confirmed R10 starter, distance expected to suit after R9 scratch
cases.interpretation: 1200m suitability and race fitness supported result
cases.limitation: Avoid interpreting outcome as proof of percentage

lessons.result: Supported wins for Autumn Glow, Lazzura, Beatty and King Of Light
lessons.action: Keep class comparisons independent of betting prices; inspect strongest rivals.

lessons.result: Savvy Spy, Ourgirlcanrun and Horseshoe Hill won where pre-race setup was favourable
lessons.action: Require evidence of course configuration and likely early position; test these assumptions by race.

lessons.result: Tempted fifth; pulmonary haemorrhage identified only AFTER the race
lessons.action: Flag unproven straight-course conditions and long preparation separately; do not train on retrospective medical finding.

lessons.result: Birdman beat Cosmic Crusader after an unlucky Cox Plate and prior Underwood win
lessons.action: Check strongest rival trajectory and traffic-affected runs before conferring a big gap.

lessons.result: Cashout sixth, despite 32.3% analyst working share
lessons.action: Flag weak transfer assumptions; require documented class-strength comparison or abstain from A tier.

lessons.result: 31 Oct Sheza Alibi (18.64pp gap) and Where'stheprofit (16.91pp) both sixth or worse
lessons.action: Prohibit automatic A-tier based on gap alone; test robustness and calibrated performance.

postrace_analysis.next_validation: Track prospective Top 5/10/15 snapshots frozen before each Saturday; evaluate Brier/log loss on fully specified race fields. Do not retroactively tune coefficients from these 25 reviewed picks.
